package.name: gimbal_serial_42
package.description: Serial bridge for the teaching gimbal kit (OffboardLink 0x01 IMU in, optional 0x30 rate command out). Publishes the configurable imu_topic (default /red_standard_robot1/gimbal, sensor_msgs/Imu) and TF world to gimbal_link. Protocol: protocol/PROTOCOL.md v1.4. The optional Hikvision camera driver is NOT included in this copy; WITH_HIK_CAMERA defaults to OFF.
